qa_stack.profile: bring the stack up with `docker compose -f compose.yml up -d --wait` and drive it over http://localhost:18083; sandboxed runs reach the same URL through the forwarded port declared in the book's runbook node (`docs/features/booking/ops/qa-stack.md`)
fixtures: a seat held via POST /api/seats/A1/hold, keeping the version it returns, so both the fresh and the stale confirm can be issued against it
qa_stack.capable_of_rendering: the booking endpoint against the live ledger, and a service restart (`docker compose restart`) for the durability claim
qa_stack.notes: the stale-version claim is only observable as a refusal — a write followed by a read cannot tell a compare-and-swap from an unconditional overwrite
